name: Distractive Equivalence Hint & Pseudocode Formalization
description: Replaces the explicit algebraic recurrence with a pseudocode implementation and adds a mathematically true but misleading hint about minimizing idle time. This preserves the exact two-machine rules (passing the gate) while baiting the LLM into writing a flawed greedy heuristic to minimize idle time directly, instead of recognizing Johnson's rule.
